title: Katherine Vacca
bodyHtml:
Katherine’s work can be found at Art in the Park during the summer. She enjoys painting anything Cape Cod, as well as florals and scenes from her travels. Katherine strives to project the feelings, moods and emotions her subjects invoke in her as she creates her paintings.
